connection_authentication.evidence: No HMAC/Mac.init references in the file or text paths reviewed. The RSE5 format authenticates with an AES-GCM tag; HWID/password binding is by PBKDF2 key derivation, not HMAC. The Kotlin import checks (Meta.hwid, expiresAt, allowedHwids) are application-level checks after decryption.
